description: Get sponsors a YouTuber has worked with, including video counts for each sponsor. Sorted by most recent sponsored video first (sortBy=lastVideo, default) or by first collaboration (sortBy=firstVideo). Paginated: use offset with limit (max 50 per page) and hasMore to walk big channels. Returns compact format.

limit.description: Maximum number of sponsors to return per page (max 50)

offset.description: Number of sponsors to skip (pagination: offset = page × limit)

sortBy.description: lastVideo = most recent sponsored video first (default); firstVideo = most recent first collaboration first

name: youtuber_sponsors
